lines.en: label bar35:
scene barwakaosako1
I make my way to the bar to be immediately greeted by not only a warm atmosphere, but the warm smile of a girl under five feet tall.
lines.zh: 我一路走到酒吧，迎面而来的不只有温暖的氛围，还有一个身高不足五英尺的女孩温暖的笑容。

lines.en: : {i}You’re so adorable.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你真是太可爱了。{/i}

lines.en: : Hm?...What was that?
lines.zh: : 嗯？……你刚才说什么？

lines.en: : Just saying hello.
lines.zh: : 打个招呼而已。

lines.en: : How’s the bar doing?
lines.zh: : 酒吧生意怎么样？

lines.en: scene barwakaosako2
: Umm...the same as always, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯……跟平时一样吧。

lines.en: : My mom isn’t feeling well tonight so I’ve...gotta do everything on my own again.
lines.zh: : 我妈今晚不太舒服，所以我又……得一个人扛起所有事了。

lines.en: : Really? What happened?
lines.zh: : 是吗？出什么事了？

lines.en: : She may have...sampled too many of the products.
lines.zh: : 她可能是……试喝了太多自家的货。

lines.en: : Oh. {i}That{/i} kind of not feeling well.
lines.zh: : 哦。是{i}那种{/i}不舒服。

lines.en: : Right...
: Well, thankfully, it’s not like this place is busy or anything.
lines.zh: : 不过还好，这地方又不忙。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure roughly half of your sales are just...me.
lines.zh: : 我敢说你这儿大概一半的营业额……都是我贡献的。

lines.en: scene barwakaosako3
: Well...while that’s normally true...there’s someone here tonight that’s drinking a lot more than I’ve ever...seen {i}you{/i} drink before.
lines.zh: : 嗯……平时确实是这样……不过今晚这儿有个人喝得比我……以前见{i}你{/i}喝的多多了。

lines.en: Sana redirects her gaze to a table in the back of the room that I must have overlooked upon entering.
lines.zh: Sana 把目光转向房间后面的一张桌子，看来我进门时漏看了那边。

lines.en: I guess I’ve gotten so used to this place being completely dead that I’ve just stopped observing my surroundings.
lines.zh: 大概是我太习惯这地方死气沉沉，连观察四周都省了。

lines.en: But knowing that it’s the back of the room, there’s a good chance that it’s the same old women who-
lines.zh: 不过既然是在房间最里面，十有八九又是那几个老面孔的女人——

lines.en: scene barwakaosako4
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Those two know each other?
lines.zh: : 她们俩认识？

lines.en: : Do you...know them, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你……认识她们吗？

lines.en: scene barwakaosako5
: I’m surprised you don’t. Well, the one on the right, at least.
lines.zh: : 你居然不认识，我挺意外的。至少右边那个你该认识吧。

lines.en: : Why would I know her? This is her first time coming in.
lines.zh: : 我为什么会认识她？她可是第一次来。

lines.en: : She’s not...some kind of celebrity, is she?
lines.zh: : 她总不会是……什么名人吧？

lines.en: : That’s Ms. Watabe- The teacher in the classroom next to ours.
lines.zh: : 那是 Watabe 老师——我们隔壁班的那位老师。

lines.en: : Does that not ring a bell?
lines.zh: : 一点印象都没有吗？

lines.en: : Sensei...I don’t know if you’ve realized this, but...
lines.zh: : Sensei……我不知道你有没有意识到……

lines.en: : I kind of keep my head down all day in[school].
lines.zh: : 我在[school]里整天都是低着头的。

lines.en: : I don’t even think I can...name another teacher.
lines.zh: : 我大概连……另一位老师的名字都说不出来。

lines.en: : I literally just told you the name of one.
lines.zh: : 我刚刚才告诉你一个。

lines.en: scene barwakaosako6
: Ms...Watanabe?
lines.zh: : 那……Watanabe 女士？

lines.en: : Watabe. You did that on purpose.
lines.zh: : 是 Watabe。你是故意的吧。

lines.en: scene barwakaosako7
: Sorry...but there’s only enough room in my head for one teacher.
lines.zh: : 对不起……可我脑子里只装得下一个老师。

lines.en: : {i}You’re so adorable.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你真是太可爱了。{/i}

lines.en: : You need to speak up...You’re being really quiet tonight, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 你得大声点……Sensei，你今晚声音太小了……

lines.en: : Yeah, well, you’re really quiet all the time. I’m just giving you a taste of your own medicine.
lines.zh: : 是吗，可你平时一直都很小声。我只是在以其人之道还治其人之身。

lines.en: : Well I need to...go give those girls a taste of more...medicine...so...
lines.zh: : 那我得……去给那几位再多上点……药……所以……

lines.en: : Just because your mother uses it to medicate both herself and you does not make it medicine, Sana...
lines.zh: : Sana，你妈拿它给她自己和你治病，不代表它就是药……

lines.en: : But fine. Why don’t I help you?
lines.zh: : 行吧。要不我来帮你？

lines.en: : Help me?
lines.zh: : 帮我？

lines.en: : You mean like...you’ll carry the-
lines.zh: : 你是说……你会帮我搬……

lines.en: : I won’t be carrying anything.
lines.zh: : 我什么都不会搬。

lines.en: scene barwakaosako8
: Of course you won’t...
lines.zh: : 你当然不会了……

lines.en: : I just want to see how you interact with other adults.
lines.zh: : 我只是想看看你是怎么跟其他大人打交道的。

lines.en: : We’ve practiced your public speaking enough that it’s time for us to conduct our first field test.
lines.zh: : 你的当众讲话我们练得够多了，是时候做第一次实地测试了。

lines.en: : You kind of...stopped teaching me about speaking altogether...you just sit there and drink now.
lines.zh: : 你早就……不教我怎么说话了……你现在就坐在那儿喝酒。

lines.en: : True, but my intentions are pure.
lines.zh: : 没错，可我的意图是纯粹的。

lines.en: No they aren’t.
lines.zh: 才不是呢。

lines.en: : So...you’re going to follow me to their table and just...watch me?
lines.zh: : 所以……你要跟着我走到她们那桌，然后就……看着我？

lines.en: : Doesn’t that sound...a little weird for...pretty much everyone involved?
lines.zh: : 这听起来……对在场几乎所有人来说都有点怪吧？

lines.en: : Ms. Watabe is dead inside so it will only be weird for three of us.
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师内心已经死了，所以只会有我们三个觉得怪。

lines.en: : It gives me an excuse to go say hi to them anyway.
lines.zh: : 再说这也给了我一个过去打招呼的借口。

lines.en: : Umm...okay, but...can you just...try not to be awkward?
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧，不过……你能不能……尽量别那么尴尬？

lines.en: : You’re the one telling {i}me{/i} not to be awkward?
lines.zh: : 这话居然是{i}你{/i}在跟我说别尴尬？

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how popular I am?
lines.zh: : 你知道我有多受欢迎吗？

lines.en: : With [teenage]girls or...regular people?
lines.zh: : 在[teenage]女孩里，还是……在普通人里？

lines.en: : Mostly the former. But there are plenty of adults who love me as well.
lines.zh: : 主要是前者。不过喜欢我的大人也不少。

lines.en: : Just ask your mom.
lines.zh: : 问问你妈就知道了。

lines.en: : Uhh...I’d really rather not...
lines.zh: : 呃……我还是别了……

lines.en: : Anytime she talks about you I...kind of want to slap her in the face...
lines.zh: : 每次她谈起你，我就……想扇她一巴掌……

lines.en: : Getting jealous that she might steal me away from you?
lines.zh: : 吃醋了？怕她把我从你身边抢走？

lines.en: scene barwakaosako9
: Jealous? Me?
lines.zh: : 吃醋？我？

lines.en: : You really think I’d get jealous from...my mom and my best friend talking about you all the time?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我会因为我妈和我最好的朋友整天念叨你……就吃醋？

lines.en: Clearly. I didn't even mention Ayane and she brought her up anyway.
lines.zh: 显然是的。我根本没提 Ayane，她自己就把人给搬出来了。

lines.en: : Hahaha...Sensei, that’s so crazy...hahaha...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……Sensei，你真是太离谱了……哈哈哈……

lines.en: : I love listening to all of the things they say about you and...not being able to contribute to the conversation at all.
lines.zh: : 我最喜欢听她们讲你的那些事了……而且自己什么也“贡献”不出来。

lines.en: : What do you mean you can’t contribute to the conversation? I’m here for {i}you{/i} tonight, aren’t I? Just...brag about that.
lines.zh: : 什么叫贡献不出来？我今晚是为{i}你{/i}来的，不是吗？你就……拿这个吹一下呗。

lines.en: : It means I'm choosing you over them.
lines.zh: : 这说明我选的是你，不是她们。

lines.en: Well, at least for right now.
lines.zh: 好吧，至少此刻是这样。

lines.en: scene barwakaosako10
: Are you really, though?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: scene barwakaosako7
: A-Anyway...I guess...feel free to follow me to the table and...see how much I’ve improved thanks to your...pure intentions.
lines.zh: : 总、总之……我想……你就跟着我去那桌，看看多亏了你那……纯粹的意图，我进步了多少吧。

lines.en: scene black
Sana comes out from behind the bar and I get out of my chair to follow her.
lines.zh: Sana 从吧台后面走出来，我也从椅子上起身跟上她。

lines.en: The girls in the back of the room notice this and begin to tone down their conversation in preparation for more booze.
lines.zh: 房间后面的那两位姑娘注意到我们，便把谈话的音量压了下去，准备接着喝。

lines.en: They also finally notice my presence, which makes me feel a little bit better about overlooking {i}them{/i} when I first came in tonight.
lines.zh: 她们终于也注意到了我，这让我今晚进门时漏掉{i}她们{/i}的愧疚感稍减了几分。

lines.en: scene barwakaosako11
: Woah. When did you get here?
lines.zh: : 哇哦。你什么时候来的？

lines.en: : A little while ago. I didn’t realize you two were friends.
lines.zh: : 有一会儿了。我都不知道你们俩是朋友。

lines.en: : Is it really such a surprise to you that I have a life outside of the[school]?
lines.zh: : 我除了[school]之外还有自己的生活，你就这么惊讶吗？

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah.
lines.zh: : 有点，是啊。

lines.en: scene barwakaosako12
: Um...can I...help you two with anything else?
lines.zh: : 嗯……两位……还需要点什么吗？

lines.en: : Speak louder. You’re too quiet.
lines.zh: : 大点声。你太安静了。

lines.en: : Another beer for me. Probably four more for my {i}friend{/i} here.
lines.zh: : 再来一杯啤酒。我这边这位{i}朋友{/i}大概还得来四杯。

lines.en: : Five.
lines.zh: : 五杯。

lines.en: : I can still feel things. It’s troublesome.
lines.zh: : 我还能感觉到东西。真麻烦。

lines.en: : Also, do you guys have like, some taxi service you’re partnered with or anything?
lines.zh: : 还有，你们这儿有没有合作之类的出租车服务？

lines.en: : She drove tonight and I definitely don’t want to get into the car with her.
lines.zh: : 今晚是她开的车，我可绝对不想上她的车。

lines.en: : If I’m lucky, maybe I’ll drive off of a cliff.
lines.zh: : 运气好的话，说不定我会开着车冲下悬崖。

lines.en: : Good luck finding a cliff in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 祝你在 Kumon-mi 能找到悬崖。

lines.en: : We, umm...don’t really have anything like that, but...I can check on my phone if that will help you...
lines.zh: : 我们……嗯……确实没有那种服务，不过……我可以用手机帮你们查查，要是能帮上忙的话……

lines.en: scene barwakaosako13
: Would you like anything, {i}Sensei{/i}?
lines.zh: : 你要不要来点什么，{i}Sensei{/i}？

lines.en: : Are you...offering to buy me a drink?
lines.zh: : 你这是……要请我喝一杯？

lines.en: : No. I was going to order the rest of whatever you wanted so you wouldn’t be able to have any.
lines.zh: : 不是。我本来打算把你想喝的全点光，让你什么都喝不上。

lines.en: : Of course I was offering to buy you a drink.
lines.zh: : 我当然是要请你喝一杯了。

lines.en: : I’m extremely drunk. Can’t you tell?
lines.zh: : 我醉得厉害。你看不出来吗？

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 还真看不出来。

lines.en: : Well, whatever. You missed your chance.
lines.zh: : 算了，随便吧。你错过机会了。

lines.en: : Okay, so...six more beers total...
lines.zh: : 好的，那就是……一共再加六杯啤酒……

lines.en: : Is there anything else?...
lines.zh: : 还需要别的吗？……

lines.en: scene barwakaosako14
: You should order the spaghetti. It’s really good here.
lines.zh: : 你们该点份意面。这儿的意面特别好吃。

lines.en: : Huh? This place has a food menu? I had no idea.
lines.zh: : 啊？这地方还有菜单？我都不知道。

lines.en: : It...doesn’t...
lines.zh: : 没有……

lines.en: : Sensei is just being...a big jerk...and tormenting me...
lines.zh: : Sensei 只是……很混蛋……在故意捉弄我……

lines.en: : Ooooooh okay, okay. So this guy’s your teacher.
lines.zh: : 哦——好好好。所以这家伙是你的老师。

lines.en: : Here I was thinking he was just getting himself involved in a {i}second{/i} relationship with a girl your age.
lines.zh: : 我还以为他是跟一个你这么大的女孩谈了{i}第二{/i}段恋爱呢。

lines.en: scene barwakaosako15
: S...Second?
lines.zh: : 第……第二？

lines.en: : There’s a first?
lines.zh: : 还有第一段？

lines.en: : Yeah. Some loud blonde girl that trains at my dojo with him.
lines.zh: : 是啊。一个吵吵嚷嚷的金发女孩，跟他一起在我的道场训练。

lines.en: : Sana, meet my karate instructor, Osako.
lines.zh: : Sana，这位是我的空手道教练，Osako。

lines.en: : She also works at a local ma-
lines.zh: : 她还在本地一家 ma-

lines.en: scene barwakaosako16
: Hey! You’re not forgetting that I can kick your ass, are you?!
lines.zh: : 喂！你没忘了老娘能揍扁你吧？！

lines.en: : You said you wouldn’t tell anyone!
lines.zh: : 你说过不会告诉任何人的！

lines.en: : I said I wouldn’t tell anyone {i}at the dojo{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我说的是不会告诉{i}道场里{/i}的任何人。

lines.en: : Life’s a fuckin’ dojo. Tell ANYONE-anyone and I’ll break your fucking arms.
lines.zh: : 人生就是他妈的道场。你敢告诉任何人——任何人，我就打断你的胳膊。

lines.en: scene barwakaosako17
: So it’s just...karate and not...an actual relationship.
lines.zh: : 所以只是……空手道，不是……真的在谈恋爱。

lines.en: : I knew Ayane went but...I didn’t know you were going there too, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我知道 Ayane 去了，可……我不知道你也去那儿，Sensei……

lines.en: : Really? It’s weird that she never told you given how much she apparently talks about me.
lines.zh: : 是吗？她那么爱聊我，居然没跟你说过，挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : All of the things she says about you are a lot...um...more {i}romantic{/i}.
lines.zh: : 她说的那些关于你的事……嗯……要{i}暧昧{/i}得多。

lines.en: : So the rumors were true.
lines.zh: : 这么说那些传言是真的了。

lines.en: : Stop bringing up those {i}entirely baseless{/i} rumors and finish your beer, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 别再提那些{i}毫无根据{/i}的传言了，把你的啤酒喝完，Wakana。

lines.en: : I’ve been finished with this one for five minutes.
lines.zh: : 这一杯我五分钟前就喝完了。

lines.en: : I’m still waiting on another but you’re distracting this poor girl from doing her job.
lines.zh: : 我还在等下一杯呢，可你一直在妨碍这可怜的姑娘干活。

lines.en: scene barwakaosako18
: O-Oh! I’m...s-sorry! I-
lines.zh: : 啊、啊！我……对、对不起！我——

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. There’s no way I’m going to remember any of this in the morning, anyway.
lines.zh: : 别放在心上。反正到了早上我肯定什么都记不起来了。

lines.en: : You’re way too competent for how drunk you apparently are.
lines.zh: : 就你醉成这样而言，你未免太能干了。

lines.en: : I...umm...I’ll be right back...
lines.zh: : 我……嗯……我去去就回……

lines.en: scene barwakaosako19
Sana suddenly scurries off to the counter and begins to stack a bunch of cans on a tray to bring over, leaving me alone with Osako and Wakana.
lines.zh: Sana 忽然小跑回吧台，开始把一堆罐装啤酒码到托盘上端过来，把我一个人留给 Osako 和 Wakana。

lines.en: : You know it’s prohibited for students to have part-time jobs, correct?
lines.zh: : 你知道学生打工是被禁止的吧？

lines.en: : Are you telling me none of your students have jobs?
lines.zh: : 你是说你的学生里一个打工的都没有？

lines.en: : Not anymore. You took the three that did.
lines.zh: : 现在没有了。原本有的那三个都被你抢走了。

lines.en: : You don’t plan on doing anything about it, though, right?
lines.zh: : 不过你也没打算管，对吧？

lines.en: : What would I even do? Get them all fired and force them to sell their bodies to put themselves through college?
lines.zh: : 我还能怎么办？让她们全被开除，然后逼她们卖身读完大学？

lines.en: : Or are they so far behind in their education thanks to your genius teaching strategies that college isn’t an option in the first place?
lines.zh: : 还是说托你那套天才教学法的福，她们的功课已经落下太多，压根就别想上大学了？

lines.en: : Wow. You two are a lot closer than I thought.
lines.zh: : 哇。你俩关系比我想象中好多了。

lines.en: scene barwakaosako20
: We’re very good friends.
lines.zh: : 我们是非常好的朋友。

lines.en: We are?
lines.zh: 是吗？

lines.en: : Our relationship aside, how do you two know each other?
lines.zh: : 先不谈我们的关系，你们俩是怎么认识的？

lines.en: scene barwakaosako19
: Figured you’d know since you guys are so close.
lines.zh: : 你们关系这么好，我以为你知道呢。

lines.en: : Wakana and I live together.
lines.zh: : 我和 Wakana 住在一起。

lines.en: : Have for a few years now.
lines.zh: : 已经住了好几年了。

lines.en: : We met in college.
lines.zh: : 我们是在大学里认识的。

lines.en: : I would die for her if the need arose.
lines.zh: : 如果有需要，我愿意为她去死。

lines.en: : You would die for anyone or anything at this point.
lines.zh: : 就你现在这状态，你为谁、为什么东西死都行。

lines.en: : Not you, you fucking buffoon.
lines.zh: : 除了你，你这个蠢货。

lines.en: scene barwakaosako21
: Hahaha! I haven’t seen her get along this well with somebody in years.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！我好多年没见她跟谁处得这么好了。

lines.en: : I’m actually kind of impressed.
lines.zh: : 说实话我还挺佩服的。

lines.en: {i}This{/i} is getting along with Wakana?...
lines.zh: {i}这{/i}就叫跟 Wakana 处得好？……

lines.en: scene black
Sana comes back moments later and bashfully places an entire six pack on the table, telling Osako and Wakana they can just help themselves and let her know if they need anything else.
lines.zh: 过了一会儿 Sana 回来了，腼腆地把整整一提六罐啤酒放到桌上，让 Osako 和 Wakana 自取，需要什么再叫她。

lines.en: I decide to leave the two of them alone and retreat back to the counter with Sana to recap the {i}incredibly purposeful{/i} experiment we just had.
lines.zh: 我决定让她们俩清静清静，跟着 Sana 退回吧台，复盘一下刚才那场{i}极有意义{/i}的实验。

lines.en: scene barwakaosako22
: You didn’t cry when I said “spaghetti.” Great job, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我说“意面”的时候你没哭。干得漂亮，Sana。

lines.en: : I’d...appreciate it if you’d stop bringing that up all the time...
lines.zh: : 你别老是提那件事……我会很感激的……

lines.en: : It’s one of my fondest memories of you.
lines.zh: : 那是我对你最珍贵的回忆之一。

lines.en: : Why is me getting so flustered that I started crying a...good memory for you?
lines.zh: : 我慌得哭出来这件事，怎么就成了你的美好回忆了？

lines.en: : To be fair, I don’t have much to work with. Our relationship has been limited to pretty much the bar and your room.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我手头素材不多。我们的关系基本就局限于这间酒吧和你的房间。

lines.en: : And[school], but...
lines.zh: : 还有[school]，不过……

lines.en: scene barwakaosako23
: Y-Yeah...I’m not really like Ayane and...the two of us don’t have the kind of relationship that is able to make memories like that...
lines.zh: : 是、是啊……我毕竟不像 Ayane……我们俩之间也不是那种能留下这种回忆的关系……

lines.en: : Are you being jealous again now, Sana?
lines.zh: : Sana，你这是又吃醋了吗？

lines.en: Instead of refuting that immediately like I expect her to, Sana hesitates.
lines.zh: Sana 没有像我预想的那样立刻否认，而是犹豫了。

lines.en: She plays with the knot of her tie, undoing it slightly with her fingers and drawing attention to how slender her neck is.
lines.zh: 她拨弄着领带的结，用手指把它稍稍松开，反倒让人注意到她的脖子有多纤细。

lines.en: If that outfit really did belong to her brother (Which I’m sure it did because why would she lie?), he must have been very small as well.
lines.zh: 如果这套衣服真是她哥哥的（我确信是的，她有什么理由撒谎呢？），那他生前一定也很矮小。

lines.en: I guess being short is just...a Sakakibara gene or something.
lines.zh: 看来个子矮大概就是……Sakakibara 家的基因什么的。

lines.en: : I’d like...to try karate too, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我也想……试试空手道，Sensei……

lines.en: : {i}You’re so adorable.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你真是太可爱了。{/i}

lines.en: scene barwakaosako24
: Again?! Why are you so quiet today?!
lines.zh: : 又来？！你今天怎么这么小声？！

lines.en: : Why not ask Ayane if you want to get into karate? She’s been going there longer than I have.
lines.zh: : 你想学空手道，为什么不去问 Ayane？她去的时间比我还长。

lines.en: : You said that you knew she did it, so why wait until now to come out and talk about wanting to try?
lines.zh: : 你刚说你知道她练空手道，那为什么到现在才开口说想试试？

lines.en: Obviously, the answer is because now she knows I’m involved and she’s worried about things progressing any further with Ayane and me.
lines.zh: 答案显然是：现在她知道我也掺和进去了，她担心我和 Ayane 的关系会进一步发展。

lines.en: But {i}also{/i} obviously, there’s no way I’d actually come out and tell her I know that.
lines.zh: {i}同样{/i}显然的是，我绝不可能直接告诉她我看穿了。

lines.en: It’s my job to feign density for the sake of her comfort.
lines.zh: 为了让她自在，装傻充愣是我的职责。

lines.en: And not just hers, but the comfort of everyone around her as well.
lines.zh: 不只为她，也为了她身边所有人的自在。

lines.en: Sana still needs to come out of her shell, and for that-
lines.zh: Sana 还需要走出自己的壳，而为此——

lines.en: scene barwakaosako23
: Because I want to...do it with you...
lines.zh: : 因为我想……和你一起做……

lines.en: And there it is.
lines.zh: 来了。

lines.en: I’m surprised she put it so bluntly, though.
lines.zh: 不过我挺意外，她说得这么直白。

lines.en: scene barwakaosako25
: Ah! W-w-w-w-wait! By “do it” I meant karate! Not the other thing!
lines.zh: : 啊！等、等、等、等、等等！我说的“做”是指空手道！不是那件事！

lines.en: : I’m aware that you meant karate, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我知道你说的是空手道，Sana。

lines.en: : You are?!
lines.zh: : 你真的知道？！

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : So...so now me freaking out makes it seem like I w-w-was thinking about the other thing?!
lines.zh: : 那、那我现在这么慌，岂不是显得我刚才一、一直在想那件事？！

lines.en: : A little bit, yes.
lines.zh: : 有一点，是的。

lines.en: : You should calm down before your other customers in the back of the room take notice.
lines.zh: : 你先冷静下来，免得房间后面那几位客人注意到。

lines.en: : N-n-n-n-notice what?! That I want to do karate?!
lines.zh: : 注、注、注意到什么？！注意到我想练空手道？！

lines.en: : I love karate! Please teach me karate, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我最喜欢空手道了！请教我空手道吧，Sensei！

lines.en: : Hm? You guys talkin’ about karate over there?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你们在那边聊空手道呢？

lines.en: scene barwakaosako26
: Oh! Uhh...look at the time!
lines.zh: : 啊！呃……看看都几点了！

lines.en: : I’ve gotta go...take care of something in the back!
lines.zh: : 我得去……后面处理点事！

lines.en: : Uhhhhhh bye!
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃再见！

lines.en: scene black
Sana runs away and trips over a rubber mat in front of the door to the back room, banging her head before letting out a high pitched shriek and tumbling inside.
lines.zh: Sana 跑开时绊在后房门前的橡胶垫上，撞到了头，尖叫一声摔倒在里面。

lines.en: I think about getting up to help her but realize that she’d likely rather be alone right now- at least until she’s able to calm herself down.
lines.zh: 我想起身去扶她，但转念一想，她现在大概更想一个人待着——至少等她冷静下来再说。

lines.en: And, of course, that happens several minutes later.
lines.zh: 当然，几分钟后她果然冷静了。

lines.en: She returns to the bar and everything goes back to normal.
lines.zh: 她回到吧台，一切恢复如常。

lines.en: With her being shy and me being me.
lines.zh: 她还是那么害羞，我也还是我。

lines.en: But progress was made today.
lines.zh: 但今天有进展。

lines.en: If Sana is ever going to get anywhere, she needs to start being honest with herself...and start being honest {i}to{/i} others.
lines.zh: Sana 要是想有什么长进，就得开始对自己诚实……也开始对{i}别人{/i}诚实。

lines.en: And I don’t mean just me.
lines.zh: 我说的不只是我。

lines.en: I mean to Ayane and Sara as well.
lines.zh: 也包括对 Ayane 和 Sara。

lines.en: If she’s so bothered by their incessant need to bring me up in conversation, the least she can do is find a way to “contribute” as well.
lines.zh: 既然她那么介意她们没完没了地要把我挂在嘴边，那她至少也该想办法让自己也“贡献”点什么。

lines.en: That won’t ever happen if she doesn’t change.
lines.zh: 她要是不改变，就永远不会有那一天。
